style: Linocut and watercolor with reading-evidence diagrams
provider: Built-in image generation and deterministic SVG diagrams
note: Pictures support interpretation of the editable lesson text; they are not standalone evidence or answer keys. Numerical records and named practice stories are fictional. Read each sort in its stated context. Educator review is pending.

sources.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: square AlloPack lesson illustration. A small urban stream with grassy banks, a footbridge and a few collected litter bags standing securely on the bank, not in water. A clear sample jar sits upright on a flat stone in foreground, no markings. No people or fish. Soft linocut with watercolor washes, restrained blue-green and earth colors. Text-free: no writing, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Focus on the stated lesson objects; do not add students, decorative badges, explanatory arrows or captions. Keep the subject complete and easy to identify at small size.
sources.alt: A linocut stream passes under a footbridge; a sample jar and filled litter bags stand on the bank.
sources.caption: This setting supports the invented River Project passage. The picture alone cannot establish water quality, explain causes or verify a reported result.

sources.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: square AlloPack lesson illustration. An organized community recycling work area with two open plain collection tubs, clean empty metal cans in one, flattened cardboard in the other. No logos, labels, arrows or recycling symbols. Linocut and watercolor on cream, three-quarter view, obvious material differences, no people. Text-free: no writing, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Focus on the stated lesson objects; do not add students, decorative badges, explanatory arrows or captions. Keep the subject complete and easy to identify at small size.
sources.alt: Two open tubs separate empty metal cans from flattened cardboard.
sources.caption: This scene introduces the fictional recycling-cost argument. The lesson’s invented accounts must be checked; the image does not show actual savings or local recycling rules.

assets.caption: Two threads represent two central ideas traced through the same text. Use evidence from more than one paragraph; a text does not always have exactly two ideas.

assets.alt: A schematic page has a highlighted middle line and a magnifying-glass outline beside it.
assets.caption: Locate the information offered as support and check its source. The bars represent text; use actual words and observations from the activity.

assets.alt: A coral arrow points to the gold middle line of a schematic page.
assets.caption: Identify a location, quote accurately or paraphrase faithfully, and explain how it supports your point. Citation and explanation have different jobs.
